name: blender complete beginner add delete and focus
goal: After basic navigation, delete/add mesh objects, focus selection, use F3 search, and save the .blend.

source.title: Getting started - Blender for complete beginners

outputs.name: scene_with_primitives
outputs.description: Scene with user-added mesh primitives, file saved

constraints: Shift+A or Add menu for meshes
Numpad period focuses selection; Numpad 0 camera view

steps.action: Dismiss splash; practice orbit/pan/zoom; use View Selected (numpad period) if lost.
Learn F3 operator search (context-sensitive to Object mode vs elsewhere).
File → Save As to create your .blend early.
Select default cube; X → Delete (Enter) to remove it.
Shift+A → Mesh → add primitives (cube, monkey, etc.); practice add/delete.
Numpad 0 (or camera icon) to preview camera framing used for renders.
